{{Top|leg}}
'''First Trooper''' or '''Grade 1 trooper''' was an enlisted [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]]. First Troopers were fairly rare within SpecForces, and were eligible to command [[Fire team/Legends|Fire Teams]].<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
